beats.visualAction: Cover headline KI-AGENT: SO HANDELT ER appears with one clean target card.
Three tiny step-by-step instruction chips collapse into one larger goal card.
Goal card emits a branching pulse that reveals the agent symbol.
Label Ziel statt Einzelschritte locks under the agent symbol.
Central goal splits into three task lanes for search, documents and notes.
Search lane activates with functional search icon and moving status dot.
Document lane activates and transfers a result chip into working memory.
Structured notes lane completes while optional generated workspace media pushes in behind it.
Question Reicht das Ergebnis? appears above a circular agent loop.
Loop travels from Execute to Check and stops on a red NO branch.
NO branch routes back to Plan while the second attempt lights up.
YES state turns green and closes the loop with Ergebnis reicht.
Large statement Kein Mensch im Kopf separates the agent from human thinking.
Model, Rules and Allowed Tools appear as three separate permission gates.
A blocked tool call hits a lock icon and stops before execution.
Human approval switch opens one guarded path and keeps the others closed.
Five-step workflow rail appears: Ziel, Plan, Tool, Check, Wiederholen.
Progress fills through Ziel and Plan while the active node enlarges.
Tool and Check nodes complete, then Repeat flashes as the loop decision.
Chat bubble shrinks while an action arrow grows toward a finished output card.
Finished supplier comparison document lands as the primary full-frame result.
Three completed checklist rows reveal one after another on the result document.
Control, Protokoll and Freigabe guardrail chips surround the finished result.
Final line KI + Aktionen locks in while the camera settles for the outro hold.
